current_detail: H1-R2.37 was accepted by the user and reviewed on 2026-08-30: 226 registered bodies, zero same-face collisions and 2.59 mm minimum opposing-face clearance against the 0.70 mm rule. Its exact current marker is verification of the live factory route, MOQ and price for onsemi FSUSB42MUX / JLCPCB C11355. The next two fail-closed prerequisites are an exact factory-placeable service-VBUS detector/latch and the Pack/Safety powered-off-Ioff isolation boundary with separate 3V3_MAIN/AON pull-ups on Hub GPIO42/43. Native R2 ECAD export, KiCad placement/routing, purchasing and fabrication have not started and remain unauthorized.
